section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure of a laboratory study utilizing a 3-hour computerized decision-making simulation called TIDE2. Participants were assigned to interdependent roles (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie) within teams, each with specialized information. The study involved training and decision trials, with a gradual communication link failure introduced between Bravo and Charlie to observe team adaptation, focusing on the final 20 decision trials for analysis.
